title: raftkv
tagline: A Raft-replicated key-value store written in Rust, with Redis-compatible wire protocol and gRPC peer-to-peer transport. Pure state machine consensus core with deterministic simulator.

title: Code-Repair-Agent with Execution-Grounded RL
tagline: Trains an LLM agent to resolve real GitHub issues from SWE-bench using GRPO. Reward comes from running the project's actual test suite inside ephemeral Docker sandboxes.

title: NCERT RAG Bot: AI-Powered NCERT Tutor
tagline: An intelligent AI tutor using RAG pipeline for conversational Q&A from NCERT Class 10 PDFs with local LLM integration, smart text chunking, vector search, and memory-based context retention.

title: Instant Canteen: Smart Campus Food Ordering
tagline: Full-stack web app streamlining campus canteen operations with pre-order meals, instant UPI-based QR payments, real-time vendor dashboard for menu management and order tracking.

title: AI-Based Music Recommendation System
tagline: Python-based GUI app that recommends songs using ChatGPT with Spotify and YouTube Music API integrations for real-time mood-based suggestions.

title: TapCart: NFC-Based Smart Retail System
tagline: IoT-integrated retail platform enabling tap-to-shop purchases and real-time inventory sync across devices via NFC technology.

title: COVID-19 Genome Mutation Visualization Tool
tagline: Visualization tool to compare genome sequences of COVID-19 variants and visualize protein structure mutations via ChimeraX with phylogenetic analysis.
